name: moh731V2023HivTestsBase
description: MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) 1.1 HIV Tests, step 3: the tested clients -- one row per qualifying test, at most one per client per day (moh731V2023HivTestDays), with its result, setting, population type, HBV screening in the period and the client's identifiers. Carries a flag column per HV01 figure (1.1 HIV Tests, 1.2 HIV Positive Results 2.1 Maternal HIV Testing, 2.2 HIV Positive Results and 2.3 Start HAART at ANC, L&D and PNC, and 2.5 AGYW), which the aggregate sums and the patient list filters on, so a figure and its linelist are always the same rows.
